title: HARAPPA
note: PLACEHOLDER COPY — dev-team stand-ins. This is the second surface (PRD §7). It shares the client but not the content namespace: no block here may read yammaman-brand content, and the loader enforces that.

seo.description: HARAPPA — an Aizu Momen mill, one of two remaining in Fukushima.

props.heading: HARAPPA
props.subheading: A cotton mill. The craft it runs on is considerably older than the company.

body: HARAPPA weaves Aizu Momen on looms that were built for it. The mill takes commissions from Yammaman and from anyone else who wants cloth that behaves like this.
Weaving capacity is finite and honest: what the mill can produce in a season is what exists.

steps.title: Weave to order
steps.body: A fabric that is out of stock but still weavable goes back on the loom rather than out of the catalog.

steps.title: Dye in indigo
steps.body: Traditional Aizu Momen indigo, which is why the colour moves as the cloth ages.

steps.title: Hold a queue
steps.body: Commissions are scheduled against loom time, not warehouse stock.

props.heading: Looking for the clothing?
props.body: Yammaman is the made-to-order label that HARAPPA weaves for.
